name: min_turns-inclusive-boundary
note: 3 user-role messages interleaved with 2 assistant replies (5 messages total); min_turns:3 is inclusive (>=) and counts only user-role turns, so it matches even though the message count is higher.

name: max_turns-inclusive-boundary
note: A single user turn misses min_turns:3, then matches max_turns:1 (inclusive <=).

name: between-bounds-default
note: 2 user turns is above max_turns:1 and below min_turns:3, so neither rule matches and it falls through to default.

name: floor-at-least-one-turn-empty-messages
note: An empty messages array still reached the router, so turn_count floors to 1 unconditionally rather than staying 0 -- matching max_turns:1.

name: floor-at-least-one-turn-no-user-role
note: A non-empty conversation with no role:user entry at all still counts as 1 turn, matching max_turns:1.

name: responses-input-array-counts-user-role-items
note: The same user-role counting applies to the Responses input array form: 3 user items among 4 total match min_turns:3.

name: min_turns-trace
note: route_trace:true records the matching leaf under condition 'min_turns'.

name: max_turns-trace
note: min_turns-rule misses first (traced false), then max_turns-rule matches under condition 'max_turns'.
